name: Structure - Default (seed v1)
description: A building or plot inside a district, with its own WorldGuard region. Gates are structures too but have their own page.

sections.description: What the structure is called and what it is for.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in game and in the web app.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: One line for admins, e.g. what the building is used for.

sections.description: Where the structure stands. Street and district are changed with Edit.

fields.label: Street
fields.description: The street the structure is on.

fields.label: House number
fields.description: The structure's number on its street. 0 = no number.

fields.label: District
fields.description: The district the structure belongs to. Its region should lie inside the district's region.

fields.label: Town
fields.description: The town that district is part of.

sections.description: The WorldGuard region that is the structure in game, and whether players may walk in and out of it.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Name of the WorldGuard region around the structure. The entry and exit rules below apply to it.

fields.label: World
fields.description: The Minecraft world the region is in. Region names are only unique within one world.

fields.label: Allow entry
fields.description: Players may walk into the region. Off keeps everyone out except admins.

fields.label: Allow exit
fields.description: Players inside the region may walk out of it.

sections.description: Whether players can /warp here and where /navigate leads. Changed with Edit.

fields.label: Warp destination
fields.description: Listed in /warp. A warp also needs a spawn location and entry allowed.

fields.label: Warp price (gems)
fields.description: Gems charged for each warp here. 0 = free.

fields.label: Only after discovery
fields.description: Only players who have discovered this structure may warp here.

fields.label: /navigate leads to
fields.description: Spawn or Region: where /navigate <structure> takes players. Empty = the default for structures.

fields.label: Road access
fields.description: Applies or Ignored: whether the entry rule keeps routes off the roads in this region. Empty = the default for structures.
